addedEvent.title: Create an event
addedEvent.description: From the home screen, tap + to plan something with your friends.

addedFriend.title: Add a friend
addedFriend.description: Scan their QR code or share your code from your profile.

importedEvents.title: Import your calendar
importedEvents.description: Connect Google, Outlook or your device, or import a file from the settings.

invitedFriend.title: Invite a friend to an event
invitedFriend.description: Open an event and tap Invite to pick from your friends.

createdDiscussion.title: Start an event chat
createdDiscussion.description: From an event, open its group chat to get organized.

fromSharedAvailability.title: Plan from a shared availability
fromSharedAvailability.description: On the timeline, tap a moment when you’re all free to create an event.
